commands.name: findings-ref-helper-hermetic
commands.run:
python3 -c 'import importlib.util,os,sys,tempfile; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("c","claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py"); c=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(c); d=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); ok=os.path.join(d,"f.md"); open(ok,"w").write("no findings
"); empty=os.path.join(d,"e.md"); open(empty,"w").close(); ws=os.path.join(d,"w.md"); open(ws,"w").write(" 
	"); ln=os.path.join(d,"l.md"); os.symlink(ok,ln); o=os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); out=os.path.join(o,"o.md"); open(out,"w").write("x"); assert c.findings_ref_error(ok,d) is None; assert c.findings_bytes(ok,d)==b"no findings
"; assert c.findings_ref_error(None,d); assert c.findings_ref_error("",d); assert c.findings_ref_error("relative/f.md",d); assert c.findings_ref_error(os.path.join(d,"..","f.md"),d); assert c.findings_ref_error(out,d)=="must be under the orchestration state root"; assert c.findings_ref_error(os.path.join(d,"missing.md"),d); assert c.findings_ref_error(empty,d)=="is empty"; assert c.findings_ref_error(ws,d)=="is empty"; assert c.findings_ref_error(ln,d); assert c.findings_ref_error(d,d); big=os.path.join(d,"b.md"); open(big,"wb").write(b"x"*(c.FINDINGS_MAX_BYTES+1)); assert c.findings_ref_error(big,d)=="is too large"'

commands.name: stop-gate-unit-suite
commands.run: env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL sh claude/hooks/herdr-stop-gate.test.sh

commands.name: stop-gate-pane-tests-present
commands.run: for t in test_other_pane_is_released_without_instruction test_designated_pane_is_still_refused_without_record test_other_pane_review_attempt_is_released test_legacy_row_ignores_pane_environment test_missing_pane_variable_is_not_designated test_codex_wrapper_prints_empty_object_for_other_pane; do grep -q "def $t(" claude/hooks/herdr_stop_gate_test.py || { echo "missing: $t"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: orch-suite
commands.run: env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL sh claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh

commands.name: orch-provenance-and-findings-checks-present
commands.run: for l in 'findings_ref_error table' 'run_headless strips the pane identity' 'emit provenance: other pane exits 3' 'emit provenance: other workspace exits 3' 'emit provenance: missing pane variable exits 3' 'emit provenance: refused before any directory is created' 'emit provenance: designated pane records emitter fields' 'emit-done provenance: other pane exits 3' 'findings-ref: invalid files are refused' 'findings-ref: wrong pane wins over bad findings' 'findings-ref: required under HERDR_ENV' 'findings-ref: same-head content rewrite is refused' 'confirm-review: native record needs a readable findings file' 'pr_ready grounding: deleted findings file refuses the approval'; do grep -qF "check \"$l" claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh || { echo "missing: $l"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: claude-hooks-suite-with-gate-cases
commands.run: env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh

commands.name: gate-case-pane-env-cases-present
commands.run: grep -q 'legacy row ignores a foreign HERDR_PANE_ID' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh && grep -q 'legacy row ignores an empty HERDR_PANE_ID' claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh

commands.name: headless-scrub-present
commands.run: grep -q 'def strip_pane_identity(' claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py && grep -q 'strip_pane_identity(child_env)' claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py && grep -q 'strip_pane_identity(child_env)' claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py

commands.name: agent-runtime-suite
commands.run: env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT bash claude/hooks/agent-runtime.test.sh

commands.name: orch-contract-suite
commands.run: env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL sh claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh

commands.name: dispatch-suite
commands.run: env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT bash claude/hooks/herdr-dispatch.test.sh

commands.name: suites-unset-herdr-pane-env
commands.run: for f in bin/dotfiles-tests claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh claude/hooks/herdr-stop-gate.test.sh claude/hooks/herdr-coordination.test.sh claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh claude/hooks/herdr-dispatch.test.sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh; do grep -q 'HERDR_PANE_ID' "$f" && grep -q 'HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID' "$f" || { echo "missing unset: $f"; exit 1; }; done; grep -q '"HERDR_PANE_ID": "pane-1"\|HERDR_PANE_ID="pane-1"' claude/hooks/herdr_stop_gate_test.py

commands.name: docs-skill-reads-findings-before-verdict
commands.run: grep -q 'findings_sha256' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md && grep -q 'findings_ref' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md && grep -qi 'stray stop' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md && grep -q 'emitter_pane_id' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md && grep -q 'herdr-orch/<slug>/artifacts/<task_id>/<launch>' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md
